title: Once More Unto the Mailbox, Dear Friends

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of five shards (Bant, Esper, Grixis, Jund, Naya) discussed in the column.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: An Alaran shard imagined as 'Camelot on the savannah', with knights and castles.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: An Alaran shard with Mesoamerican-flavored cat-people, elves, humans and gargantuan beasts.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: An Alaran shard of etherium, artifact creatures and the Ethersworn.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: An Alaran shard of undead hordes.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A savage, predatory Alaran shard of dragons and goblins.

entities.name: Vithia
entities.description: A mostly-forgotten Alaran kingdom whose descendants live in Grixis.

entities.name: Qasal
entities.description: A fortified Nacatl city in the jungles of Naya.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient dragon over twenty millennia old, jaded, pursuing infinite power and complete knowledge.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker who is one of the main protagonists of the novel Alara Unbroken.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A hotheaded pyromancer planeswalker starring in the novel The Purifying Fire.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker with a brain-skewering spell.

events.summary: Some Grixis humans stayed behind rather than emigrate after the Conflux.
events.quote: I actually do think there are some living Grixis humans who didn't emigrate after the Conflux.

events.summary: Descendants of Vithia in Grixis hope to rebuild the fallen kingdom as green and white mana trickles back.
events.quote: these neo-Vithians might hold out hope that they could rebuild the kingdom's fallen glory

relations.note: Vithia is an Alaran kingdom, mostly forgotten.
relations.quote: the mostly-forgotten Alaran kingdom of Vithia

relations.note: Qasal is a fortified Nacatl city.
relations.quote: the fortified Nacatl city of Qasal

relations.note: Ajani is a main protagonist of the novel Alara Unbroken, set in Alara.
relations.quote: Alara Unbroken features the planeswalker Ajani as one of its main protagonists
